title: Gold study Nov-2026 (pre-registered): 5 falls ≥20% since 1968, median −39%, recovery 43m (1980: −62%/26y; 2011: −39%/9y); real yields explain falls/recoveries, Fed label doesn't; at real yield ≥2% next-12m median ~0%; 12m P best/base/bad/worst 9/52/34/5%
body: Full study: research_notes/Gold/gold_study_2026-11/gold_study.md (prereg.md, results.json, data/). Tools: tools/gold/fetch.py, study.py. Monthly-average history WB/LBMA (+datahub mirror 2025-26, cross-checked vs Yahoo GC=F). Today 27-Nov-2026 GC=F $3,639.6 (spot $3,650): −31.6% from best close $5,318 (29-Jan-2026), −27.5% vs monthly-avg ATH $5,020 (Feb-2026). Q1: ≥20% episodes 1973 −21%/6m, 1974-76 −40%/43m, 1980-99 −62%/316m, 2008 −21%/18m, 2011-15 −39%/106m. Q2: run-ups ≥2.5x/36m median −40% vs −21/−39 for 2.3x: weak, n=5. Q3: 12m gold vs 12m Δreal yield corr −0.39/−0.42; fwd12 median by Fed label hiking 7.1% / cutting 6.9% / hold 1.4% (no signal); by real-yield level <0 −4.6%, 0-2 +12.8%, ≥2 +0.5% (47% negative); recoveries began with falling real yields 5/5. Q4: INR better in 91% of negative USD 12m windows, median +7.5pp, still negative 59%; rupee strengthened ~3% since Aug-2026 so no cushion now. India duty 15% since 13-May-2026 explains IBJA vs world gap (residual +1.5%). Q5: LBMA consensus beat no-change 5/5 years, MAPE 10.1% vs 12.5% (narrow; misses turning points); no named fund house 'accumulating below $3,600/$3,500' found; Q3 CB buying (321t, 63% unreported) happened at ~$4,270 avg; floor not evidenced. Scenarios 12m best(>+25%)/base/bad/worst(<−25%) 9/52/34/5% pre-registered (episode-weighted 16/61/22/1); 24m 23/30/42/5 (46/31/22/2). L52 rule: Jan-2026 reset sold gold worth 9.2% of portfolio (gold at 29%); Jan-2027 would buy ~4% if price holds; further −16% costs a 70/20/10 portfolio ~3%. Research, not advice.

title: India raised effective gold/silver import duty to 15% (10% BCD + 5% AIDC) from 13-May-2026 (Budget Feb-2026 had left it at 6%)
body: Two+ outlets (Goodreturns 13-May-2026, IIFL; also Khaleej Times, Telangana Today 2-Jun-2026); one outlet says 18.4% (conflict, not adopted). Lok Sabha reply Aug-2026: Rs 10,463 cr collected 13-May to 2-Aug. Explains the ~16% IBJA vs world-price gap flagged in L51 (residual premium ~+1.5% on 27-Nov-2026). Rollback to 6% would cut domestic price ~7.8%. Primary CBIC notification not yet read.
